title: 第7章 想吃了你们呢第8章 大佬也要跪着纳投名状
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
十几分钟之后。
“琉璃灯！！你怎么样？！！”
远处的街道，只见数十个全副武装，每一个身上都装备着多件圣器的驱魔师以难以想象的速度赶了过来。
而他们立刻就颤抖地看到了街道正中央瘫坐在那里的那个小萝莉。
她表情空洞，小手哆哆嗦嗦地紧抓着裙子。
如果不是因为听到了【灵钟】。
看到这一幕，恐怕他们都会以为他们的队友，在这里受到了难以想象的欺负与凌辱。
“琉璃灯！你还好吗！我是你的队长琼斯！我们刚刚接到通报，这里到底发生了什么？！”
为首的一个青年咬牙，第一时间想要将她搀扶而起。
但刚一看到她的脸，他的心就猛地一颤。
“你的眼睛……”
因为他们非常清楚，琉璃灯她可是天生具备【破妄之瞳】的神选之人，她的那双眼睛能够勘破一切怪诞的本源。
可是……怎么会……
“没……我没事。”
琉璃灯小脸苍白，哆嗦地伸出小手，用力地抱紧了胸脯。
“有一个位格极高的怪物……降……降临了，我的眼睛勘不透祂，灵界所有的怪物都在逃，它们在害怕……那个怪物不仅位格极高，而且还掌握着古代的神语，我怀疑……我怀疑祂可能是神灵时代就存在的……一个超古代大魔……”
此言一出，在场所有的人全都是脸色大变。
尽管他们的心里早有准备。
但听到她的话，他们还是感觉到一阵阵的震惊与惊悚。
而尽管感觉到荒诞。

但是再加上那灵钟的九声钟鸣，也由不得他们不相信。
因为二十年前的那个大魔降临时，灵钟也才响了七声。
“祂……祂没有杀你？你还知道什么情况？！”
那个青年立刻急切地询问。
琉璃灯的声音越来越低，颤动道：
“祂说，祂要把这个地方当成祂新的巢穴，而且也不会轻易地回去，我猜测……这可能只是祂入侵我们世界的第一步……等祂真的在这里站稳脚跟，那也许很快，祂就会在我们这儿掀起一场巨大的祸乱……然后吃掉全世界！”
那个青年瞳孔一缩。
“祂现在在什么地方？！”
她的小手虚弱地向着远方指去。
“齿轮大街……祂要……吃光那里所有的人……”
说完之后，她的脑袋一歪，昏了过去。
“琉璃灯！！”
……
content_en:
Ten minutes later.
"Liu Li Lan!! How are you?!!"
In the distant streets, dozens of fully armed exorcists, each equipped with multiple sacred weapons, were seen rushing over at an unimaginable speed.
And they immediately saw the little loli slumped there in the middle of the street with trembling eyes.
Her expression was empty, and her little hands were trembling, clutching her skirt tightly.
If it weren't for hearing the [Spiritual Bell].
Seeing this scene, I'm afraid they would all think that their teammates were being bullied and humiliated in an unimaginable way.
"Liu Li Lan! Are you okay! I am your captain Jones! We just received a notification, what happened here?!"
A young man in the lead gritted his teeth and immediately wanted to help her up.
But as soon as he saw her face, his heart skipped a beat.
"Your eyes..."
Because they knew very well that Liuli Deng was the one chosen by God who was born with the [Destroying Eyes of Illusion], and her eyes could detect the origin of all weirdness.
But...how could...
"No...I'm fine."
Liuli Deng's face was pale, and she stretched out her trembling hands and hugged her chest tightly.
"A monster with a very high status... has descended... and I can't see him clearly. All the monsters in the spiritual world are running away, they are afraid... That monster is not only of a very high status, but also masters the ancient divine language. I suspect... I suspect that he may have existed in the age of gods... a super ancient demon..."
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of everyone present changed drastically.
Although they were already prepared in their hearts.
But when they heard her words, they still felt waves of shock and horror.
And even though it feels absurd.
But coupled with the nine chimes of the spiritual bell, they couldn't help but not believe it.
Because when the great demon came twenty years ago, the spiritual bell only rang seven times.
"He...he didn't kill you? What else do you know about?!"
The young man immediately asked eagerly.
Liuli Deng's voice became lower and lower, and he trembled:
"He said that He will regard this place as His new lair, and will not go back easily. I guess... this may be just the first step in His invasion of our world... When He really establishes a foothold here, then maybe very soon, He will cause a huge chaos here... and then eat the whole world!"
The young man's pupils shrank.
"Where is He now?!"
Her little hand pointed weakly into the distance.
"Gear Street...He will...eat all the people there..."
After she finished speaking, her head tilted and she fainted.
"Glass lamp!!"
